syn: systemd-sysext [OPTIONS...] COMMAND ⏎ systemd-sysext.service ⏎ systemd-confext [OPTIONS...] COMMAND ⏎ systemd-confext.service

o.en: Print a short help text and exit.
Print a short version string and exit.

Operate relative to the specified root directory, i.e. establish the "overlayfs" mount not on the top-level host /usr/ and /opt/ hierarchies for sysext or /etc/ for confext, but below some specified root directory. Added in version 248.

When merging system extensions into /usr/ and /opt/ for sysext and /etc/ for confext, ignore version incompatibilities, i.e. force merging regardless of whether the version information included in the images matches the host or not. Added in version 248.

When refreshing system extensions on /usr/ and /opt/ for sysext and /etc/ for confext, ignore when the existing merged extensions already match what would be merged. By default the refresh is skipped when no changes are found.

Takes an image policy string as argument, as per systemd.image-policy(7). The policy is enforced when operating on system extension disk images. If not specified, defaults to "root=verity+signed+encrypted+unprotected+absent:usr=verity+signed+encrypted+unprotected+absent" for system extensions, i.e.
Set mutable mode. The special value "help" will list the known values. no force immutable mode even with write routing directories present. This is the default. Added in version 256.
When merging configuration extensions into /etc/ the "MS_NOEXEC" mount flag is used by default. This option can be used to disable it. Added in version 254.

When used with merge, unmerge or refresh, do not reload daemon after executing the changes even if an extension that is applied requires a reload via the EXTENSION_RELOAD_MANAGER= set to 1. Added in version 255.
Do not pipe output into a pager.
Do not print the legend, i.e. column headers and the footer with hints.

Shows output formatted as JSON. Expects one of "short" (for the shortest possible output without any redundant whitespace or line breaks), "pretty" (for a pretty version of the same, with indentation and line breaks) or "off" (to turn off JSON output, the default).
